Milk-removed reruns of the four prior successful basket triples

The prior results are preserved for provenance; each corresponding COMPOSE task removes milk_1 and its initialization region before a fresh five-episode evaluation.

  • COMP_205 1/5 → COMPOSE_152 (milk removed) 0/5
  • COMP_209 1/5 → COMPOSE_155 (milk removed) 2/5
  • COMP_213 1/5 → COMPOSE_158 (milk removed) 0/5
  • COMP_223 3/5 → COMPOSE_164 (milk removed) 0/5

Two-cabinet feedback follow-up

The earlier task kept only one cabinet. These new variants explicitly use the LIBERO-10 white cabinet at robot-left and the LIBERO-Goal wooden drawer at robot-right. The wine bottle uses its exact Goal initialization coordinate.

  • Kitchen-anchored: 24 tasks / 120 episodes; the Kitchen4 scene is retained and the Goal drawer plus corrected wine pose are added.
  • Goal-anchored: 24 tasks / 120 episodes; the complete Goal scene is retained and only the Kitchen4 white cabinet is added.
  • Result: 1 task(s) with success / 4 successful episode(s). No reviewer selection has been applied.

COMP_209 / COMPOSE_155 Object-and-milk follow-up

The unchanged Object 3-step (200 tasks) and 4-step (150 tasks) spaces had already produced zero successful tasks, so this screen changes the obstruction or required execution order instead of repeating those controls.

  • LIBERO-10 Scene 2: require milk first, or move milk beside ketchup.
  • LIBERO-Object: require milk first in all six milk-containing scenes, or swap milk into the upper/back object slot in five scenes.
  • COMPOSE_155: reuse its exact milk-removed states and append cream cheese, ketchup, or orange juice only after the successful three-object prefix.
  • Result: 2 successful task(s) / 3 successful episode(s); successful families: {'L2_long_milk_beside_ketchup_3_to_basket': 1, 'O2_object_milk_upper_swap_3_to_basket': 1}.
